reviews.author: Marco Kedro
reviews.text: Upon arriving at Maki & Ramen, we were warmly welcomed by a cheerful team member—complete with the traditional drum bang greeting. We were promptly shown to a spotless, comfortable booth. Service was exceptionally fast; our order was taken almost immediately, and the food arrived shortly after. We paired our meal with the Makibiru beer, which was fantastic. We started with a selection of fresh sushi, followed by the Tonkotsu Ramen for our main course. The ramen was served piping hot, and the quality of everything truly blew me away—it is easily one of the best meals I have ever had. I highly recommend visiting this restaurant for incredible food, great drinks, and a wonderful atmosphere.

reviews.author: Felitsiia Kryvenko (felisss)
reviews.text: Worst customer service ever with rude workers who make disgusted faces at you. Came on Friday around 14:00 in a small group. We did get a table pretty fast, however when taking our order the waiter just forgot about one of people and was ready to leave the table. It is not a big issue since we all are people, however everything that happened next highlighted this too. Next, the orders would be placed perfectly like everyone ordered apart from one. One person had to reach all the way across the table to get ALL their orders just because waiters were too lazy to bring it closer to them, and when asked to put one dish a bit closer, the waiter made yet another face and almost threw the dish with anger. Moreover, when asked for a bill, one really rude guy tried to overcharge me for a lunch deal that we never ordered. Lunch deal for £18 includes main, side, and a drink, and it looks like he tried to charge us for TAP WATER. When asked what’s going on and why, he kept being rude and wouldn’t take responsibility for his mistake. He kept saying that he’s in right, we’re wrong, and if he charges it correctly it will be more expensive. I wasted almost 10 minutes explaining math to this guy, until he finally left and someone brought us a correct bill (which was actually cheaper like it should be, not more expensive like that rude man kept saying). Lastly, when we asked to pay separately for what we ordered, we were told they cannot do that, we have to tell them all prices. Fair enough, just be prepared to pull up a calculator if you still want to attend this place. But when we said that we won’t pay their INCLUDED tip, the waitress dared to look annoyed. Well, the service was bad, and this is me being polite. I explained to her everything that happened and was met with a “I don’t understand what’s the problem”. Go talk to your male co-worker that worked on Friday and ask him how he tried to overcharge us, I’m sure he’ll be happy to show you his frustration over lost money. Maki & Ramen, just because people are drinking doesn’t mean they won’t notice awful customer service or overcharges in the bill. You treated one person badly and lost 4 loyal customers forever, well done!

reviews.author: Agata Wolanska
reviews.text: Really disappointed with our visit to Maki & Ramen Aberdeen. We’ve been to the Glasgow restaurant before and absolutely loved it, so we were really looking forward to coming here, especially as we don’t get many days out together. Unfortunately, the experience was disappointing from the start. The restaurant was extremely cold and the air conditioning was absolutely freezing, to the point that it was uncomfortable sitting there. There was also no beer available, which was annoying, although we ordered some wine instead. The food was where things really went downhill. My partner’s egg arrived cold, and the prawns and other seafood had a really strange texture and tasted as though they had been pre-cooked and left sitting for some time. When our waiter asked how the meal was, we were honest and explained the issues with the food. His response was simply, “That’s odd,” and nothing further was offered or done, which we found quite disappointing considering we had clearly said we weren’t happy with the meal. My partner then became very unwell after eating, which unfortunately spoiled what had been a rare day out together. Of course, we can’t say for certain what caused this, but given our concerns about the seafood during the meal, it certainly added to our disappointment. We really begrudged paying what we did for an experience and meal that were so poor. It’s particularly disappointing because we love the Glasgow restaurant and had expected the same standard in Aberdeen. Sadly, based on this visit, we wouldn’t rush back.

She said she had no idea whether the chicken came in prepacked or ready cooked. She said we would not have to pay. We would have refused anyway as we had one mouthful each. reviews.text: This place uses the word Halal but serves alcohol. It's a mockery.

reviews.author: Emily Cars
reviews.text: Really disappointed with our experience. It took half an hour for anyone to just take our drink orders. The fried chicken starters were really chewy and rubbery. Both the ramen and yakisoba noodles seemed like they had just been heated in the microwave and lacked flavour. All the food had a strange artificial flavour as well. Would not recommend

reviews.author: Amna Ahmed
reviews.text: The chicken was overly salty, ramen lacked flavour other than salt. Chicken was also soggy. Katsu curry was average at best- the sauce was nice but chicken felt like frozen food you air fry. Rice was stiff. Staff were polite and served us quickly but the food is heavily lacking. Wouldn't return.

reviews.author: RACE MAK
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my meal at Maki Nori in Soho. The handrolls were freshly made and the A5 Wagyu and Duck Foie Gras ones were definitely my favourites. The sashimi was fresh too, and I really liked the presentation of the sushi boat with dry ice. We also had the Hokkaido Cheese Tart for dessert, which was a nice way to finish the meal. Overall, a lovely place for a date night or special occasion. Would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Maria Helena Barbosa
reviews.text: Amazing service from Jada 🤍🤍🤍

reviews.author: Dom
reviews.text: The food is incredible, without a doubt. I wish I could rate higher than 5 for the service alone. Navin is an asset to the business offering excellence and charm to the experience. I don’t wanna sound like an AI plug so def will b recommending to my friends and colleagues!

reviews.author: Nick S
reviews.text: We had an incredible time at Maki Nori Food was spectacular! All the seafood was super fresh and flavourful, make sure you try the handrolls & crudo! Navin went above and beyond ensuring we had an amazing night. He made sure we're were comfortable and gave us the best service we've had in London so far. The entire team were incredible and the vibes immaculate. Would absolutely recommend ❤️

reviews.author: Asad-ali Rehemtulla
reviews.text: Kaitlin and Navin made every effort to make us feel comfortable and laid out the menu and special Chef's items for us. Most of the menu is Halal friendly with no alcohol in the sushi rice and all the sauces which is rare for a Japanese in central. The food was fantastic Amazing Nagiri and Sashimi. The Chef's Ceviche and the Miso Aubergine hand roll were outstanding. Definitely coming back
